newsitem.title: USA: Loewen offering valued at $396 mln.
newsitem.headline: Loewen offering valued at $396 mln.

text.p: Funeral home operator Loewen Group Inc said on Thursday that its public offering of 12 million shares was priced at $33 a share, valuing the deal at $396 million.
U.S. and Canadian underwriters have been granted an overallotment option to buy up to an additional 1.8 million common shares, Loewen said.

Loewen said proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including acquisitions. Pending the use of the proceeds for those purposes, the company will cut borrowings, Loewen said.
Smith Barney Inc and Nesbitt Burns Securities Inc managed the stock offering.
